{{otheruses|Bunduki}}
'''Bunduki''' was an interpretive style of dancing<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> that originated the eponymous planet [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]].<ref name="PA2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bunduki dance appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Bunduki was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 20 Notes for 19 July 2005|Publish 20]]," on [[July 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="PA2005" />
